title: DOE-01: Missing-document acquisition ticket
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named implementing agency
summary: GAO-23-104661 Recommendation 1 receives a missing-document acquisition ticket with an exact target, custodian, repository route, three directive-element decisions, stop rule, and reopening trigger.
key_findings: Likely custodian: NNSA Office of Plutonium Modernization.
Acquisition status: Exact artifact not acquired from a public repository.
Directive element 1: Full pit-production capability life-cycle scope — Not established by located public record. Locator: No separately public exact artifact acquired as of 2026-08-02.
Directive element 2: GAO-aligned cost-estimating method and assumptions — Not established by located public record. Locator: No separately public exact artifact acquired as of 2026-08-02.
Directive element 3: Risk and uncertainty analysis across the production capability — Not established by located public record. Locator: No separately public exact artifact acquired as of 2026-08-02.

Stop rule: Stop the bounded public-search pass after the named program, publication, reading-room, budget, and current GAO surfaces have been checked; reopen on a new exact-title, correspondence, attachment, or custodian lead.
Reopening trigger: A new agency attachment, public exact-title match, successor directive, GAO page update, or named custodian release.
Next action: Route the exact-title query to NNSA Office of Plutonium Modernization; monitor the named repositories and GAO page for a public attachment. No request has been submitted by FTFN.
why_it_matters: The queue turns a generic missing-or-adjacent evidence gap into a reproducible retrieval route or a bounded page-level sufficiency record without claiming authority FTFN does not have.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOE-01 and its exact recommendation identity.
